note: Gold labels for the real sessions of a third-party MIT corpus. No transcript text is stored here: sha256 is over the block's stripped text, and bench/secondary.py reads the text back out of the clone. `items` is every distinct user-role prose block, labelled by three annotators who worked independently and were forbidden to read this repository. `emitted_assistant` is every distinct assistant block the extractor scored `reversal`, adjudicated by three more against the same definition -- an adjudication, not a blind labelling, so it measures precision only. `votes` is how many of the three the stored label carries. The `file` values are the upstream corpus's own directory names and some encode its author's home directory; they are kept because they are how an item is found in the clone, they are published by that project under MIT, and they name nobody on this machine.
